name: leanrea
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and other agents the skills CLI supports
short: One small AI skill that helps your agent reverse engineer apps and binaries with ordinary command-line tools.
what: leanrea is a single 8 KB SKILL.md for reverse engineering. It tells your agent the fastest command for each kind of target, such as Electron apps, Mach-O binaries, Go builds, Android APKs, WASM or pcap files, and lists common traps. The agent then runs the real tools itself through the shell. In the author's benchmark it was faster and cheaper than the REA MCP server at about the same accuracy.
who: Security researchers and developers who need to see how an app or binary works. Skip it if you don't do reverse engineering.
needs: A coding agent that can run shell commands
The tools for your target, such as asar, otool, nm, jadx, apktool, Ghidra, tshark, binwalk or sqlite3

steps.title: Install it
steps.text: This uses the skills CLI, which asks which agents to install it for.

steps.title: Or install it by hand
steps.text: If an agent has no skills support, paste `leanrea/SKILL.md` into its rules or system prompt.
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/aicodeking/leanrea
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -R leanrea/leanrea ~/.claude/skills/

try.label: From the README
try.text: /leanrea How does the search feature in Foo.app work? Show the evidence.

watch: Your agent runs reverse engineering tools directly in your shell. The skill's first rule is to work on a copy of the target.
The benchmark used 3 runs per case, one model and one machine, and some tools were not installed. Treat the numbers as a rough guide.
